name: @cerasos/intercall
description: Bidirectional InterCall RPC for TypeScript browser clients
author: Luiz Gustavo Ceraso Filho <gus@ceraso.dev>

scripts.build: npm run build:browser && npm run build:cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run test:browser-imports && npm run test:binding && npm run test:codec && npm run test:syntax && npm run test:tool && node --test test/tool/browser-import-boundary.test.mjs test/fixtures/compiler/compiler-experiments.test.mjs
scripts.test:binding: npm run build:browser && node --test test/runtime/binding.test.mjs test/runtime/errors.test.mjs test/runtime/payload-exception.test.mjs test/runtime/empty.test.mjs test/runtime/spi.test.mjs test/runtime/chunk-queue.test.mjs test/runtime/connection-core.test.mjs test/runtime/frame.test.mjs test/runtime/request-state.test.mjs test/runtime/call-order.test.mjs test/runtime/send-gate.test.mjs test/runtime/incoming-state.test.mjs test/runtime/dispatch-result.test.mjs test/runtime/connection-runtime.test.mjs test/runtime/url.test.mjs test/runtime/options.test.mjs test/runtime/socket.test.mjs test/runtime/message-queue.test.mjs test/runtime/events.test.mjs test/runtime/raw.test.mjs test/runtime/negotiation.test.mjs test/runtime/browser-connect.test.mjs
scripts.test:codec: npm run build:cli && node --test test/codec/program.test.mjs test/codec/encoder-buffer.test.mjs test/codec/primitive-codec.test.mjs test/codec/text-codec.test.mjs test/codec/bytes-codec.test.mjs test/codec/list-codec.test.mjs test/codec/record-codec.test.mjs test/codec/codec-vm.test.mjs test/codec/budget.test.mjs test/codec/compiler.test.mjs test/codec/go-fixture.test.mjs test/codec/go-roundtrip.test.mjs test/codec/nested-budget.test.mjs
scripts.test:syntax: npm run build:cli && node --test test/syntax/scanner.test.mjs test/syntax/parser.test.mjs test/syntax/validator.test.mjs test/syntax/docs.test.mjs test/syntax/format.test.mjs test/syntax/golden.test.mjs test/syntax/fuzz.test.mjs
scripts.test:tool: npm run build:cli && node --test test/tool/interface-id.test.mjs test/tool/name.test.mjs test/tool/mangle.test.mjs test/tool/selector.test.mjs test/tool/depth.test.mjs test/tool/import.test.mjs test/tool/import-validation.test.mjs test/tool/import-emitter.test.mjs test/tool/exception-emitter.test.mjs test/tool/codec-emitter.test.mjs test/tool/binding-emitter.test.mjs test/tool/client-emitter.test.mjs test/tool/metadata-emitter.test.mjs test/tool/generator-format.test.mjs test/tool/generated-check.test.mjs test/tool/import-golden.test.mjs test/tool/compiler-project.test.mjs test/tool/directives.test.mjs test/tool/source-discovery.test.mjs test/tool/export-golden.test.mjs test/tool/cli-args.test.mjs test/tool/cli-diagnostics.test.mjs test/tool/cli-transaction.test.mjs test/tool/cli-ownership.test.mjs test/tool/cli-import.test.mjs test/tool/cli-export.test.mjs test/tool/cli-help.test.mjs test/tool/integration-fixtures.test.mjs
